name: Victoriana Vasquez — marriage in January 1875, Degollado, Jalisco, Mexico
researcher_question: When and where did Victoriana Vasquez, daughter of Remigio Vasquez and Bernarda Sandoval, marry Jose Cleofas Gutierrez?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 32, hint-samples.csv row 935, flag adds_marriage, confidence 3). Resolved OUTCOME 1 (true match) on an INDEX-ONLY route. The 9 Jan 1875 Degollado, Jalisco marriage of Jose Cleofas Gutierrez and Victoriana Vazquez (hint ark:/61903/1:1:JC8N-Y3P, Mexico Marriages 1570-1950; parish counterpart ark:/61903/1:1:684J-DSBM, bride persona 684J-DSBS, Jalisco Catholic Church Records) is the marriage of tree person Victoriana Vasquez (GFG9-7H4). The marriage index names only the couple, so the match does NOT rest on the two names alone. Deciding record: the 1879 Degollado civil death registration (ark:/61903/1:1:QGWN-N5CM, Mexico Jalisco Civil Registration 1857-2000), whose index fields record Maria Victoriana Vazquez Sandoval (b.~1841, d. 2 Sep 1879 Degollado) as WIFE of Cleofas Gutierrez AND DAUGHTER of Remigio Vazquez + Maria Bernarda Sandoval — tying both the husband and the parentage of GFG9-7H4 to this couple in Degollado. Corroborated by the 1879 Degollado parish burials (ark:/61903/1:1:684J-DSKS, ark:/61903/1:1:684V-3N76) and later Jalisco civil marriages of the couple's children naming Victoriana Vazquez + Cleofas Gutierrez as parents (e.g. ark:/61903/1:1:QGQR-T5DH). image_basis false: no page images were read; the marriage and death records each carry an image but the identification rests on indexed fields only, so no Step 1a calibration applies. The Silveria Gutierrez baptism (the draft's other suggested check) was searched for and not found; it is not needed.
